goal: One uninterrupted, one-binary certificate of all four registered M12 bars.

native.order: odd repetitions ascending workers; even repetitions descending workers

modulo.order: odd sweeps ascending N; even sweeps descending N

inputs.read_only_rule: Hash every selected ARW before and after the uninterrupted campaign; require exact equality.

sidecars.source: Byte-for-byte copies of M139's registered, N-isolated sidecars. Every scored invocation revalidates its stack identity and frame count; the M192 terminal witness requires alignment ON (sidecar-override) and N placed / 0 refused.

configuration.alignment: on through a hash-pinned STREHL_WARPMAP outside the capture tree; the product reports sidecar-override
configuration.environment: All STREHL_ and thread-control variables are cleared before the recorded worker, cache, temp, and sidecar variables are set.

bars.identity: Exactly one complete-file SHA-256 and one canonical decoded-pixel SHA-256 in every fixed-worker six-run cell and across all five workers at each N.

memory_admission.primary_peak: Maximum Windows Job Object peak over all 90 scored native runs.
memory_admission.reported_cross_check: Maximum sampled process-tree private committed bytes over the same runs.
memory_admission.ratio: At each worker, maximum N299 scored peak divided by maximum N33 scored peak; report the maximum worker ratio for both Job and sampled counters.

timing_admission_without_a_scheduled_qui.decision: Use the registered raw-minimum statistic, but admit it only through a stronger reversal-pair envelope.
timing_admission_without_a_scheduled_qui.registered_statistic: For each N, minimum wall time among six scored sweeps divided by N; spread=(max-min)/min.
timing_admission_without_a_scheduled_qui.drift_cancellation: Pair each ascending sweep with the immediately following descending sweep. For each N compute both arithmetic and geometric means of per-frame time across the mirrored pair.
timing_admission_without_a_scheduled_qui.contention_envelope: For each pair take the larger arithmetic/geometric spread. The minimum and maximum across all three pairs are the empirical lower and upper bounds.
timing_admission_without_a_scheduled_qui.pass_rule: Registered spread <=0.02 and the paired-envelope upper bound <=0.02.
timing_admission_without_a_scheduled_qui.fail_rule: Registered spread >0.02 and the paired-envelope lower bound >0.02.
timing_admission_without_a_scheduled_qui.host_cpu: Sample whole-host CPU every second around every warm-up and scored sweep; report mean and peak for each sweep, plus per-invocation process-tree CPU and mean external busy fraction.
timing_admission_without_a_scheduled_qui.why_this_is_preferred: The reversal pairs cancel first-order monotone drift and the three-pair envelope exposes nonrepeatable contention. No peer pause, lock, process termination, or scheduled quiet window is used.

commissioning.unrepaired_product: The same full-output gate must show both W1/W2 identity divergence at N33 and >6 GiB at N33/W4 on the unrepaired commit.
commissioning.memory_plant: A 7-GiB child allocation must cross the process-tree memory bar while a 64-MiB null stays below 1 GiB.
commissioning.hash_plant: Flip one decoded uint16 output sample and require both complete-file and canonical decoded-pixel hashes to change.
commissioning.verifier_mutations: The independent verifier self-test must catch missing records, broken chains, hash divergence, memory failure, ratio failure, coverage failure, timing failure, and missing CPU telemetry while an inert label mutation remains green.

interruption_policy.requirement: All commissioning and all 133 registered invocations execute under one top-level campaign process. Any interruption invalidates the entire campaign directory; delete it and restart from zero.
interruption_policy.terminal_record: A certificate is valid only with an exact 133-record hash chain, matching input-after manifest, certificate.json, and campaign-complete.json.
